## Problem

`public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-mario-duplantier.md` has multiple fabricated gear facts for **Bill Ward** (Mario Duplantier's side is verified-clean). This is an LLM-citation mirror file — fabricated facts here get served to AI crawlers (ClaudeBot, GPTBot, PerplexityBot etc.) as ground truth.

## Verified ground truth

Source files: `packages/frontend/data/endorsementNews.js`, `packages/frontend/data/extendedBios.js` (Bill Ward FAQ block, confirmed directly at lines ~2340-2360), `packages/frontend/data/drummerEvolution.js:10141`, `packages/frontend/data/cymbalSetups.js:340-348`.

- Drum kit: **Ludwig Standard / Club Date Series** (not "Ludwig Classic Maple" — that's a different, modern Ludwig product line)
- Pedal: **single Ludwig Speed King Pedal** (not "Ludwig Atlas Pro double pedal" — no such model exists in the data, and Ward used a single pedal)
- Sticks: **Pro-Mark Standard 5A/5B equivalent** (not "Vic Firth American Classic 2B")
- Cymbals: 14" Avedis Zildjian hi-hats, 16"-18" crashes, 20" ride only — **no 18" China** is documented anywhere in ground truth
- Band tenure: **1968-1980, briefly 1983-1984, again 1997-1998, once more 2011-2012** (four distinct stints) — not "1968 to 1983, and again from 1997 to 2006" (two ranges, wrong end years)
- Snare (14"x6.5" Ludwig Supraphonic LM402) and Remo heads are correct, leave unchanged.

## Fix

File: `/home/runner/work/MetalDrummerGear/MetalDrummerGear/public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-mario-duplantier.md`

- Line 3: replace `"Bill Ward (Black Sabbath, 1968–1983, 1997–2006)"` with `"Bill Ward (Black Sabbath, 1968–1980, 1983–1984, 1997–1998, 2011–2012)"`
- Line 19: replace `"Bill Ward played a Ludwig Classic Maple kit with a Ludwig Supraphonic 14"x6.5" LM402 snare, driven by a Ludwig Atlas Pro double pedal, Vic Firth American Classic 2B sticks, and Remo heads."` with `"Bill Ward played a Ludwig Standard / Club Date Series kit with a Ludwig Supraphonic 14"x6.5" LM402 snare, driven by a single Ludwig Speed King Pedal, Pro-Mark Standard 5A/5B equivalent sticks, and Remo heads."`
- Line 25: remove `", 18" China"` from Bill Ward's cymbal list (Mario Duplantier's "18"/20" Chinas" stays — that's his own verified gear, don't touch it)
- Line 28: replace `"Bill Ward co-founded and drummed for Black Sabbath from 1968 to 1983, and again from 1997 to 2006."` with `"Bill Ward co-founded and drummed for Black Sabbath from 1968 to 1980, briefly again in 1983-1984, from 1997 to 1998, and once more in 2011-2012."`

Mario Duplantier's claims (Tama Starclassic Bubinga, dual 22"x18" kicks, Tama S.L.P. snare, Iron Cobra 900, signature sticks, Zildjian cymbal list, 1996-present tenure) are all verified-correct — do not change.

## Verify

1. `grep -n "Classic Maple\|Atlas Pro\|American Classic 2B\|18\" China\|1983, and again from 1997 to 2006" public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-mario-duplantier.md` returns nothing
2. `grep -n "Club Date Series\|Speed King\|Pro-Mark Standard\|1980, briefly" public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-mario-duplantier.md` returns the corrected lines
3. Mario Duplantier's gear text is byte-for-byte unchanged
4. File renders without broken markdown (no stray quote/bracket issues)

## Done

All four Bill Ward fabrications (kit, pedal, sticks, cymbal) and the tenure-years error are corrected to match `endorsementNews.js`/`extendedBios.js`/`drummerEvolution.js:10141`; Mario Duplantier's side untouched.
title: SEO: public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-mario-duplantier.md fabricates Bill Ward's kit/pedal/sticks/cymbals + wrong tenure years
